run.researchNotes: Top-up 6: adds bellwether-based Q2 FY27 business growth for Shipping and marine and Water and environment, with method in basis. The pe5yAvg gaps for indexed sectors were filled last time with peMedian and peMedianSince, because their published P/E series are shorter than five years, so they are not repeated here. All other items were searched again and are logged.

business.basis: bellwethers: revenue from Great Eastern Shipping only (consolidated Rs 1,824.42 cr vs Rs 1,241.78 cr); profit = summed consolidated PAT of Great Eastern Shipping (Rs 1,269.23 cr vs Rs 581.41 cr) and Shipping Corporation of India (Rs 578 cr vs Rs 189.16 cr), i.e. Rs 1,847.23 cr vs Rs 770.57 cr. GE Shipping's PAT includes Rs 308 cr of ship-sale gains.
business.source: GE Shipping Q2 FY27 results filed 06-11-2026 (Univest, Multibagg); SCI Q2 FY27 results declared 04-11-2026 (Sovrenn) and SCI Q2 FY26 PAT (Business Standard Capital Market, Nov-2025); profit growth derived from the summed figures
